description:
Google Cloud BigQuery adapter for the Culvert framework. Provides
        BigQueryWarehouse, a Warehouse implementation that wraps
        com.google.cloud.bigquery.BigQuery. Registered via
        java.util.ServiceLoader so consumers can wire it without compile-
        time coupling to the GCP SDK. Sprint-1 deliverable (issue #6).
        Sibling adapters (JobControlRepository, FinOpsSink) land in this
        same module via issues #8 and #9.
